title: Pascal tiling and congruences modulo N in Pascal's triangle
summary: We investigate the properties of matrices obtained from a geometric transformation of the first $N$ rows of Pascal's triangle. For $N > 2$, their congruence properties form a \emph{Pascal tiling}, that is, a perfect alternation between entries congruent to $0 \pmod{N}$ and the others, if and only if $N$ is prime. This result yields an alternative proof of the classical congruence $L_N-1\equiv 0 \pmod{N}$ for prime $N$, where $L_N$ denotes the $N$th Lucas number.
